core_obligations: Check that F x_H G is a sheaf (proof lines 1140-1142).
Identify the diagonal as a base change of the representable Delta_F x Delta_G through the cartesian square (proof lines 1143-1155).
Produce the surjective etale chart U x_H V -> F x_H G as a composition of base changes (proof lines 1156-1170).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a sheaf H on (Sch/S)_{fppf} with representable diagonal and algebraic spaces F, G over S mapping to H, the fibre product F x_H G is an algebraic space (source lines 1130-1137). The proof checks the three defining conditions of an algebraic space: it is a sheaf; its diagonal is a base change of the representable (Delta_F x Delta_G) through a cartesian xymatrix square; and a surjective etale chart is obtained as U x_H V -> F x_H G, a composition of base changes of surjective etale maps.
